summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq Material culture/53)

data.turoyo: Tamo ánnaqqa gmoṭanwa qayse ḥlime mu+ṭuro, yarixe, lgorā́n du+ʕulyo di+dukṯo, du+ʕulyo d̥arke, du+ʕulyo di+məre. Kayle kayle makilíwanneste, be mə‿kə́twanne ínaqqayo, wăki bu+ḥuṭo makiliwa, bmən makiliwa? Mətro latwa. Zaḥme d̥owalle mətro.
data.translation: There they would then bring thick logs from the hill country, long ones, depending on the height of the place, on this here height, on the height of the lunette. Measure after measure (lit. ‘measures, measures’), they would measure them (i.e., the trunks), at that time, what would they have had, whether they measured with thread, with what did they measure? There wasn’t any metre. A metre would be difficult for them.

rationale: New Infectum-wa box; logs as object, -nne/-ste and thread instrument. One whole context supplies all repeated tokens.
